mcqs.question: According to the order issued on 1 April 2025, how many mandals in Andhra Pradesh were declared drought-affected?
mcqs.explanation: A total of 51 mandals were declared drought-affected, of which 37 were classified as severe. The tempting figure 37 refers only to the severe category, not to all drought-affected mandals.

mcqs.question: Which district had the highest number of drought-affected mandals among the six districts declared drought-hit in Andhra Pradesh in April 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Prakasam had the highest number of drought-affected mandals, with 17. Kurnool and YSR Kadapa each had 10, while Anantapur had 7, so none exceeded Prakasam.

mcqs.question: How many Compressed Bio-Gas plants did Reliance Industries plan to set up in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: Reliance Industries planned to establish approximately 500 Compressed Bio-Gas plants in Andhra Pradesh. The figures 100 and 250 relate to the capacity and employment associated with the first plant, while 20 lakh was the state’s five-year job target.
